name: @smartsoft001/claude-plugins
description: Installs the smartsoft Claude Code plugins into a project: smart-core (hooks and framework-neutral skills) plus smart-angular or smart-react (the component and CRUD skills and agents of one framework).

scripts.postinstall: node -e "for (const plugin of ['smart-core', 'smart-angular', 'smart-react']) try { require('child_process').execSync('claude plugin update ' + plugin + '@smartsoft --scope project', { stdio: 'inherit' }) } catch {}"
